messages:
vivek: following up on the token validation postmortem 19 — want to lock owners and short timelines for remediation items (validation tests, audit enrichment, rotation cadence). can we confirm?
zoe: I can own the validation tests + CI gate. plan: add a chaos-style job that rotates a key and ensures no auth error for 10m. ETA: 4 days.
marc: i'll take audit logs. need to capture `kid`, `rotation_initiator`, and `rotation_reason` in events. propose 90d hot retention. ETA: 3 days.
olivia: ops will handle rotation cadence + deploy behavior. we should avoid full restarts during rotation; prefer SIGHUP reload + staggered pods. i'll draft rollout notes. ETA: 1 week.
pagerduty-bot: created task TSK-10111: "auth-token-postmortem-remediations" (https://issues.redwood/TSK-10111)
vivek: proposed split: tests -> zoe, audit -> marc, deploy + playbook -> olivia, comms + SLA blurb -> me. owners, add triage + blockers on the task by EOD.
zoe: test sketch: `./ci/rotate-test.sh --target staging --validate 600` 19 will run nightly and on PRs touching auth. also adding an alert integration if the test fails.
marc: audit mapping draft posted to the task. sample kibana query: `event:auth.rotation and not user:system`. will add saved view.
olivia: deploy change: add key reload handler in the runtime and a 30s stagger window. will also change deploy-controller to phased rollout for critical services.
vivek: alert suggestion: `token_validation_error_rate > 0.4% over 10m` -> page oncall + assign to owners. also propose a 7-day post-rollout digest to #incidents.
zoe: i'll wire the alert and add a minimal smoke test that runs after rotation. PRs will reference TSK-10111 when ready.
marc: will share retention config and a sample saved view link in the task.
vivek: action summary for tracking: zoe: rotation e2e + CI gate (ETA 4d) | marc: audit event + retention + saved view (ETA 3d) | olivia: reload handler + phased rollout playbook (ETA 1w) | vivek: comms + SLA note + alert digest (ETA 2d). update TSK-10111 with progress, please. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: reminder set: follow-up sync scheduled in 5 days.
zoe: ack, updating task now.
marc: will post final mapping tomorrow.
